name: search_approved_exercises
description: Search approved exercises visible to the connector (read-only). Only approved exercises are returned. Supports limit (default 10, max 25) and an opaque cursor; responses include next_cursor when more results exist. When the query matches nothing, exercises is empty and search_link is the prefilled web app search URL (built from server config). Do not pass patient information.

query.description: Search text (exercise name or keywords). Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

body_region.description: Single body region label from the seeded list.

prescription_type.description: Optional filter: exercises that can be prescribed with this type.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response next_cursor. Omit on the first page.

summary.description: Plain text summary for the assistant. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

share_link.description: HTTPS share link for the program when a published version exists or after publish. Empty string when no published link applies.

manage_url.description: HTTPS link to open the related screen in the web app. Empty when no screen applies.

match_count.description: Number of approved exercises returned in exercises.

body_regions.description: Body region labels from the seeded list.

items.description: How this exercise is prescribed on this program row. Stretch exercises use stretching only. Strengthening exercises use isometric, concentric, or eccentric.

allowed_prescription_types.description: Prescription types allowed for this exercise on a program row.

exercises.description: Matching approved exercises, empty when none match.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Omit when there are no more results.

search_link.description: Prefilled web app exercise search URL when the query returned zero approved exercises. Built from server-configured base URL.

name: get_program_builder_link
description: Read-only deep link to the program builder in the web app. Pass program_code to open that program, or from_routine_id (UUID v4 opaque id) to start a new program from that routine, or omit both for a new blank program. When both program_code and from_routine_id are given, program_code wins and from_routine_id is ignored. No rows are passed in the link. Publishing and share links use get_program_share_link_or_pdf. Do not pass patient information.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

from_routine_id.description: When creating a new program, open the builder seeded from this routine id.

name: get_program_share_link_or_pdf
description: Read-only program share link and PDF lookup. Provide program_code or program_title. Never publishes. When a published version exists, returns share_link, pdf_url, and expires_at when live, plus share_link_state. When only a draft exists, publish_link opens the publish page and draft_state is draft_only. When both draft and published exist, draft_state is published_with_draft_changes and has_newer_draft is true. manage_link opens the share page for expiry, close link, and delete. Lookup by program_title works only when exactly one program matches; otherwise the tool returns error_code ambiguous_title with candidates. Do not pass patient information.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

program_title.description: Non-identifying program title the practitioner uses to recognise this program later. Do not include patient names, contact details, health card numbers, or dates of birth.

name: create_or_edit_program
description: Create or replace a program. Omit program_code to create; pass program_code to replace that program's full rows list (no incremental ops). Create from a routine with from_routine_id in one call; optional rows replaces the copied rows. Records source_routine_id on the program. Each row uses exercise_version_id or exercise_name, not both; the server resolves names and omits unresolved rows (no placeholder rows). Unresolved names appear in exercises_not_found with up to three candidates and a prefilled web app search link (built from server config). Never publishes. Do not pass patient information in program_title or row_notes.

name: publish_program
description: Publish the current program draft to the live share link (republishing updates the live version on the same link). Requires program_code. Before calling, read the program with get_program_share_link_or_pdf so you know the program name, whether a published version exists, draft_state, and current expiry. Call only after the user explicitly confirms in the conversation: say which version they want when draft changes exist (published link vs publishing the draft first), then confirm publish with default expiry or the overrides you will send. Optional overrides.expires_in sets expiry (1_week, 30_days, 90_days, 1_year, never, or custom_date with overrides.custom_date); omit overrides to use the practitioner default. Do not pass patient information.

program_code.description: Stable program code assigned by the system (for example PRG-7K3Q).

expires_in.description: Share link expiry for this publish. Omit overrides entirely to use the practitioner default.

custom_date.description: Required when expires_in is custom_date. Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD from tomorrow onward per product rules.
